## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +22.32%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +16.95%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials breadth: 11/13 positive. ## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (Energy, Industrials, Materials) given broad sector breadth and leadership; reduce exposure to weaker Technology large-caps until trend confirmation; style: Value/Cyclical over Growth/Momentum while monitoring major-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

AAPL (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +6.11%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold 1M trend would re-open tech risk. JPM (1W: +4.53% | 1M: -2.33%) RECOVERY — continued follow-through would confirm financial rebound.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +9.26% | 1M: +23.02%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +12.42% | 1M: +5.90%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +23.77%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength.
